# OpenPGP compose initialization waits for the compose-specific ready event

Entry 1192 moves the OpenPGP startup listener from window load to compose-startup-done, which ComposeStartup dispatches after its own setup. The accepted listener remains bound to Enigmail.msg and runs once. For this extension point, use the domain readiness event rather than assuming document load means gMsgCompose is ready. This is a scoped lifecycle pattern, not a rule for all load listeners. Startup order was inspected in source; no composer was opened and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: OpenPGP compose initialization.
